functions.name: c16rtomb
functions.summary: Converts a char16_t character c16 to its multibyte representation and stores it in s (up to MB_CUR_MAX bytes), updating conversion state ps.
functions.signature: size_t c16rtomb(char * restrict s, char16_t c16, mbstate_t * restrict ps);

params.name: s
params.description: Destination buffer for the multibyte character, or NULL.

params.name: c16
params.description: UTF-16 code unit to convert.

params.name: ps
params.description: Pointer to the mbstate_t conversion state.

returns.description: The number of bytes stored in s, or (size_t)(-1) with EILSEQ stored in errno on an encoding error.

evidence.heading: 7.28.1.2 The c16rtomb function
lines: size_t c16rtomb(char * restrict s, char16_t c16,
mbstate_t * restrict ps);

lines: size_t c16rtomb(char * restrict s, char16_t c16, mbstate_t * restrict ps);
_Check_return_ _ACRTIMP size_t __cdecl c16rtomb(_Out_writes_opt_(4) char *_S, _In_ char16_t _C16, _Inout_ mbstate_t *_Ps);

functions.name: mbrtoc16
functions.summary: Inspects at most n bytes from s to complete the next multibyte character and stores the corresponding char16_t value in *pc16.
functions.signature: size_t mbrtoc16(char16_t * restrict pc16, const char * restrict s, size_t n, mbstate_t * restrict ps);

params.name: pc16
params.description: Optional pointer to store the resulting char16_t.

params.name: s
params.description: Pointer to the multibyte character sequence, or NULL.

params.name: n
params.description: Maximum number of bytes to inspect.

params.name: ps
params.description: Pointer to the mbstate_t conversion state.

returns.description: 0 for a null character, 1 to n for bytes consumed, (size_t)(-3) if a buffered character was stored, (size_t)(-2) if incomplete, or (size_t)(-1) with EILSEQ in errno on error.

evidence.heading: 7.28.1.1 The mbrtoc16 function

mbstate_t * restrict ps);
